Bio

Martin Roméo LaFrenière is a Francophone filmmaker from Winnipeg, Manitoba. A member of the Directors Guild of Canada (DGC), and a recent graduate of the ASC Masterclass, he has worked as a cinematographer, director, editor and producer on documentaries, short films, music videos, and series over the past decade. His collaborators and clients include Atlantic Records, The Today Show, Six Shooter Records, New Damage Records, CBC, APTN, TFO, Unis TV, and Québecor.

Recently, Martin has occupied key creative roles across nationally broadcast productions, serving as editor on Malgré Moi (CBC) and Les Faillites d’Astrid (CBC), directing series such as C’est Moi Qui Décide (Unis TV) and Métis Foodies (APTN) and working as director of photography on Champions (TFO) and Histoires de Survie (CBC). He has also served as producer and 2nd unit Director for Faouzia’s “The Today Show” appearance with John Legend, William Prince’s “Further From The Country” album rollout, short films such as L’Appel du Vide and documentaries such as Sorry, I’m a Mess.
